description: This file defines an interface PricingService for calculating product prices and formatted currency amounts within a sales management system. It includes method signatures for price calculation considering various factors and for formatting amounts for display purposes.

classes.name: PricingService
classes.description: Interface defining pricing-related services for products, including price calculation and display formatting.

methods.name: calculateProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates final price of a product with various overloads considering customer data and product attributes.

methods.name: getDisplayAmount
methods.description: Formats a monetary amount for display according to store and locale settings.

methods.name: getStringAmount
methods.description: Formats a monetary amount without currency symbol for display purposes.
